name: python-binomial-heap
title: Binomial Heap
blurb: A mergeable integer min-heap of binomial trees: a tree of rank k holds exactly 2^k keys, the forest keeps one tree per rank, size follows the bit pattern of the count, and meld unions two heaps -- what plain heaps refuse.
default_description: A mergeable integer min-heap of binomial trees where meld unions two heaps, a tree of rank k holds exactly 2^k keys, and the forest holds one tree per rank.
